The two original-change reasons keep their old logic and original negatives. The earlier extra-duty and unplanned-obligation regressions are still tested negatively. The replay/test reasoning in the packet is consistent with these closures. No actionable correctness, security or accessibility defect could be identified within the code actually shown.
